title: KnowledgeBaseStatus
description: One knowledge base's stack as semiont status reads it: what it is, where it runs, and each of its own services. The services every knowledge base shares are reported once, in the snapshot's shared list.

name.description: What the snapshot calls the knowledge base: the last segment of its DID, or the whole DID where two would share one, or its key.

key.description: The knowledge base's key on this machine, which names its containers and its state.

recorded.description: Whether a stack of it is recorded. When none is, its services are found by name.

root.description: Its clone, for a local stack.

identityError.description: Why its identity could not be read from its clone, when it could not.

kb.description: The knowledge base as the discovery document publishes it, when it does.

gateway.description: The base URL of its gateway, from its record.

secretStore.description: Where the values the launcher generates for it are kept, as semiont settings secret-store describes it.

lan.description: This machine's address on the network, when the stack is started with network lan.

starting.description: Whether a semiont start of it holds its start lock: its services are not ready, whatever they report.

healthy.description: Whether each of its counted services, and the issuer it signs in at, answers.

services.description: Its own services, group by group, then the issuer it signs in at. Empty for a codespace's, whose services its own launcher reports.
